subject.title: Feature: config-level default task notify policy

question: What public config shape should OpenClaw support for default task notify policy: one global default or per-runtime defaults for ACP, subagent, cron, CLI, and media-like tasks?
rationale: The code path is clear, but AGENTS.md and VISION.md treat config/default additions as compatibility-sensitive product surface; automation should not choose the permanent schema and default semantics.

options.title: Per-runtime defaults
options.body: Add a strict `agents.defaults.tasks.notifyPolicy` map so operators can silence ACP/subagent completions without changing cron/CLI/media behavior.

options.title: Single global default
options.body: Add one `agents.defaults.tasks.defaultNotifyPolicy` value, accepting simpler configuration at the cost of broader message-volume impact.

options.title: No new config
options.body: Keep per-task `openclaw tasks notify` and solve only the narrower channel/runtime visibility issues separately.

recommendation.title: Per-runtime defaults
recommendation.body: Add a strict `agents.defaults.tasks.notifyPolicy` map so operators can silence ACP/subagent completions without changing cron/CLI/media behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc owns the clearest recent task delivery and ACP/subagent executor-routing history for the affected defaulting path.
